goal_gap.definition: G = V(goal entry) - V(decision step), V = sum over channels of w_c (s_c - centre_c) / max(scale_c, floor_c) with the decision's normaliser; share_by_channel = sum over decisions of the channel's part of G / sum of G

attainment.definition: within each decision, over its candidates: x = (f - mean f) x G, y = (V after the hold - V at the decision) - its mean; the slope through 0 of y on x pooled over decisions, 95% interval from resampling the bodies. 1 = ending a share f of the way to the goal tokens brings the share f of the goal's lead in ranked value; 0 = the goal progress does not move the ranked value

grounded_terms_on_progress.definition: slope through 0 of the term's within-decision deviation on f's within-decision deviation: the term's change per full goal-token progress (f from 0 to 1); hold = averaged over the 5 model steps of the hold, the five terms singly read at the hold's end

raw_channels_reproduction.definition: the same reproduction slope on the raw (not detrended) channel values, for the decisions whose goal entry was stored on this probe's main timeline (its raw values kept)
